F01_adjudication.early_refusal: Source or source/runtime acceptance refusal leaves helper and postcheck state not_entered and runtime observation fields null. Worker mode refusal also leaves them unentered. A helper capture exception leaves loading with no usable handle; finally does not retry a first load.
F01_adjudication.finding: Original parent finally could first load runtime_support after source_admission refusal. Original worker could first load it merely because the admission module existed after a failed mode/source acceptance.
F01_adjudication.known_failure_limit: Each existing postcheck sequence still short-circuits on its first error. The contract explicitly discloses unattempted later checks; a failed operation cannot claim complete custody and needs external preservation/review before any retry. This repair does not mislabel partial failure evidence as complete.
F01_adjudication.later_refusal: Once a handle exists, later errors retain applicable runtime postchecks through it. Original parent error and stop_reason are preserved when termination or postcheck also fails. Worker error remains separate from postcheck_error.
F01_adjudication.parent_complete_path: source_before -> acceptance_before -> prerequisites_passed -> loading -> runtime_helper -> captured -> verify -> profile -> loaded_files -> child creation. Finally rechecks mode, conditionally profiles and checks loaded origins using the retained handle, checks sources, conditionally verifies runtime using that handle, rechecks any established acceptance, then evaluates success. No runtime_helper/current_runtime/current_profile call occurs in finally.
F01_adjudication.repair: Both mains start with runtime=None and explicit false/not_entered state. Runtime support is assigned only after successful source verification and source/runtime acceptance, and worker command/mode acceptance. The parent separately admits mode before entering the operation. Finally branches call only methods on that retained non-null handle.
F01_adjudication.success_is_not_weakened: Parent and child require prerequisite true, captured helper, complete runtime postcheck state and every required runtime/source/acceptance before/after field present. Existing whole worker/parent equality, error-free exit, source capture, genuine run, independent saved validation, zero stderr, actual custody and optimized full-result equality checks remain.
F01_adjudication.worker_complete_path: source_before -> captured admission module -> exact command -> mode_admission_before -> acceptance_before -> prerequisites_passed -> loading -> runtime_helper -> captured -> verify/profile/loaded_files -> complete scientific capture and run. Finally checks captured bytes if obtained and sources; only a retained runtime is verified/profiled/origin-checked; only established acceptance/mode records are repeated.
